## How to retrieve

```bash
python brain/scripts/forge.py stats                    # corpus shape
python brain/scripts/forge.py query "pagination"       # full-text search, ranked
python brain/scripts/forge.py ask "how do i page results"  # top chunks + docs
```

Every page carries a `## Summary` of at most 200 characters that stands alone. An agent that
reads only summaries still gets the point of each page.

## Machine index

- [`index/topics.json`](index/topics.json) — topic → pages → summary
- [`index/entities.json`](index/entities.json) — nodes, env vars, identifiers
- [`index/graph.jsonl`](index/graph.jsonl) — `subject | predicate | object | source`
- [`data/wiki.db`](data/wiki.db) — SQLite: `docs`, `chunks`, `entities`, `triples`, `claims`, `run_log`
